Kadget Remote for Android — control your Mac running Kadget from your phone over Tailscale.

Install: download the APK on the phone and allow installing from this source. Then on the Mac open Kadget › Tools › Kadget Remote, turn it on and scan the code.

## Changes

- perf(dock): static usage, approvals and trackpad surfaces skip the tween; the reset countdown rebuilds once a minute
- fix(dock): opening a request in the sheet re-arms the approval buttons
- fix(dock): the opened request no longer keeps approvals.watch on
- fix(dock): read the whole agent request before allowing it; usage constants
- chore: Kadget 3.14.0, Remote 1.13.0 — dock usage, approvals, trackpad
- fix(dock): trackpad keeps move order on slow links and keeps the dock awake
- feat(dock): trackpad widget
- fix(dock): approval taps always answer the request the person saw
- feat(dock): approvals banner and widget
- fix(dock): keep the usage ring readable with long or stale labels
- feat(dock): AI usage widgets and AI-limit stat key
- fix(phone): hide in-flight approvals and guard stale replies
- fix(phone): re-read approvals after a failed answer
- feat(phone): usage and approvals protocol
- feat(remote): usage and approvals on the wire (Swift)
